reason: I'm looking for a place for my kid's birthday anyway, so I'd go once on the 15 zł opening hour to see the room for myself. For everyday play we have the free playground on our estate, so I wouldn't come back regularly.
objection: 650 zł for only 10 kids and 2 hours, and I don't know if that includes an animator, food or cake. Half the preschool group would be left out, and for that money I'd want someone running the party, not just a room.
would_change_my_mind: A birthday package that clearly includes an animator and snacks, with an option to add more kids for a set price per child
